evidence.name: NetworkSendDispatch

function_ir.summary: Dispatches a network data send. Obtains a sender object through the vtable method at offset 0x58 on the object pointer stored at *this; if it is null, returns 10 (blocked). If a payload (a4) is present it is forwarded through a sub-object vtable call, otherwise a flag byte in that sub-object is set to 1. Then unconditionally calls sub_586800 with fixed first arguments and a5/a6/a7 as data, and SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00 with a2/a3. Finally routes through VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall or sub_585270 depending on a8, and returns 0.

operations.description: Retrieve sender object v8 by invoking the vtable method at offset 0x58 through the object pointer stored at *this (COM-style handle).
If sender object v8 is null, return 10 to signal the send is blocked.
If payload a4 is non-zero, call the vtable method at offset 0x20 on the sub-object at v8+72 passing a4 as the data; otherwise set the byte at offset 4 of that sub-object to 1.
Call sub_586800 with fixed leading arguments 1 and 0 plus a5, a6, a7 carrying the send data.
Call SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00 with a2 and a3.
If a8 is non-zero dispatch via VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall(v8); otherwise route through sub_585270(v8).
Return 0 on the successful dispatch path.

unresolved: Role of the sub-object at v8+72 and its vtable method at offset 0x20 is unknown.
Meaning of the block return value 10 and the meaning of the a8 dispatch split (VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall vs sub_585270) is unknown.
